rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for mutual activity or interaction between people or things.

example.english: This game really emphasizes interaction between players and the computer.
example.traditional: 呢個遊戲好重視玩家同電腦之間嘅互動。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 hou2 zung6 si6 waan4 gaa1 tung4 din6 nou5 zi1 gaan1 ge3 wu6 dung6

rows.note: Use this precise technical phrase for things such as the effects of different medications on one another.

example.english: Taking these two medicines together may cause an interaction.
example.traditional: 呢兩隻藥一齊食可能會有相互作用。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zek3 joek6 jat1 cai4 sik6 ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 soeng1 wu6 zok3 jung6

rows.note: Use this for an exchange of ideas, feelings, or conversation between people.

example.english: Our interaction over dinner was an exchange of travel tips.
example.traditional: 大家食飯嗰陣交流吓旅行心得。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 sik6 faan6 go2 zan6 gaau1 lau4 haa5 leoi5 hang4 sam1 dak1

rows.note: Choose this when the interaction specifically takes the form of a dialogue or conversation.

example.english: The main character has a very touching interaction with their mother in this drama.
example.traditional: 呢套劇入面，主角同阿媽有一段好感人嘅對話。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 jap6 min6 zyu2 gok3 tung4 aa3 maa1 jau5 jat1 dyun6 hou2 gam2 jan4 ge3 deoi3 waa6
